title: Commitment
description: A provider-consumer dependency on a specific contract revision, under stated compatibility terms. This is what commitment means; a `committed: true` flag hides exactly the part that gives it meaning. An artifact-level `committed` may exist as a projection -- "has active consumer commitments" -- but never as the source record.

provider.description: The contract and revision depended upon, e.g. `session-note/v1`.

compatibility.description: The term under which the consumer depends on the provider. `exact-revision` admits no drift; `breaking` records a commitment already known to require consumer work.
